about_the_game:
The player starts off on Earth and has the choice to draw cards to move on Earth or move down a platform to enter the Underworld.

On Earth, there is a trainer that can teach you how to kill the enemy on Earth in exchange for currency. You have to land on the Earth enemy first once you are trained to kill the Earth enemy.

There is a rare gem in the underworld that can be found and brought to the blacksmith on Earth. The black smith can forge a blade out of the rare gem in exchange for currency. The blade forged from the rare gem by the black smith can kill any enemy on the board, supernatural or on Earth, if you land on the enemy first.

Bring the blade forged from the underworld gem to the guardian angels in heaven to become the most powerful on the board, being able to kill any enemy in any situation, winning the game.

The player also has a side quest to save a man’s wife who is locked up in the underworld in exchange for Earth currency. Aquire heaven currency to bribe the Underworld guard to avoid losing the game when the underworld guard lands on your position.

Be careful with acquiring heaven currency. If the Earth enemy finds out about heaven currency, it will become greedy and head to the heavens. When the heaven guard finds out that heaven currency is being distributed on Earth, it will come find you on all three platforms. If the heaven guard finds out that the underworld guard has heaven currency, it will kill the underworld guard, a good tactic to know.

Special thanks to Steven Seleb for permission to use his tunes for the soundtrack. Special thanks to Mark Jiannino for a track as well.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes a rare gem in the underworld that can kill any of the supernatural enemies in the game, which can be considered drug related content. Running into the heaven guard to where you fall back to Earth, and falling to your death after entering heaven again after drawing cards that make you fall due to the Heaven guards lack of forgiveness could be viewed as accidental death.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64 bit Windows 10 or above

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64 bit Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz
  • Memory: 5 MB RAM

short_description: Fan of chess? Looking for an otherworldly challenge? From the creator of “Diamond Board” gives you “Legend Of The Platforms”, a casual but intricate game you can play in one sitting. Deal with supernatural and ordinary enemies, forge a blade from a rare gem in the underworld, and dominate the board.
